title: Why You Need A Simple Nutrition Plan
hook: Mike Tyson once said everybody has a plan until they get punched in the face, and when you're dieting, life is going to punch you in the face.
body: Emergencies, days you don't have time for your normal breakfast, family things, your girlfriend or wife, times you're sick. When people follow a complex plan to evenly reduce calories through the day, things come up and they overeat. Intermittent fasting is a plan you can execute when life punches you in the face. If you get in an argument with your girlfriend, you still fast your five hours a day.
close: Leave a comment to let me know what usually knocks you off your diet.
